items.t: Original SUV: fuel gauge reads wrong
items.job: Replace fuel pump module with fuel level sender
items.note: The sender usually comes with the fuel pump module and the tank must be dropped.

items.t: Original SUV: electric fan clutch failure
items.note: Includes basic testing. If the wiring or connector is the cause, the repair costs less.

items.t: Original SUV: power window regulator failure
items.note: Price is per door. Rear doors take longer, and a regulator with motor costs more.

items.t: Original SUV: blower runs on one speed or keeps running
items.note: If the blower motor itself is also worn, replacing it adds cost.

items.job: Rebuild instrument cluster (replace gauge stepper motors)
items.note: Mail-in rebuild services are the cheapest route. A new or used cluster may need programming.

items.t: Crossover: turbo wastegate rattle and low boost
items.note: GM special coverage may pay for this on affected 1.2L models. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer first.
